{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the trial data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Confirm the sentinel value is -999.0
sentinel_value = -999.0

# Check how many rows have the sentinel value
sentinel_count = (trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] == sentinel_value).sum()
print(f"Number of rows with sentinel value (-999.0): {sentinel_count}")

# Drop rows with sentinel values before computing mean
trial_df_clean = trial_df[trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] != sentinel_value]

# Now, keep only the row with the highest sample_seq per patient
trial_df_clean = trial_df_clean.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False)
trial_df_clean = trial_df_clean.drop_duplicates(subset=['patient_id'], keep='first')

# Compute the mean baseline biomarker value
mean_baseline = trial_df_clean['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Print the result
print(f"\nMean baseline biomarker value (ng/mL): {mean_baseline}")"}
